scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo elementary polynomial ring and binomial facts. A finite exact verifier supplements but does not replace the infinite proof. Literature comparisons cite original works and their 2026 final article without fabricating independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns cyclic neighbour sums over finite residue rings, not the ordinary absolute-difference game. It determines maximum first-cycle-entry time, not period or transient distribution. The odd-length, prime-modulus, and pure two-power branches have earlier proofs; the new contribution proves the odd-prime-power equality conjecture and composes all branches. Bibliographic priority beyond inspected published sources is not independently certified.
title: Exact maximal transient lengths for cyclic neighbour-sum dynamics
